basis.owner_principle: For very small, well-bounded gaps, proceed without a separate NotebookLM review when the gap has been carefully evaluated and the repair is minimal.

repair.rationale: Teaching copy already directly teaches preservation of the original domain after simplification, and the Practice manifest already contains the canonical skill. The missing evidence is one isolated Grade-8 Micro opportunity.

defer.rationale: Learn and Practice are already complete. Missing explicit Grade-8 Micro evidence concerns shared/foundational data skills and does not justify density expansion now.

no_action.rationale: Grade-8-specific pyramid skills already have direct Micro evidence; shared foundation skills are not treated as a quota.
Family/local PROB-EVENT semantics already teach and diagnose possible/favourable outcomes without creating new global skills.
